q1.question: Can I try before I buy?
q1.answer: Yes! Our free demo lets you create one patient with up to 5 tests and generate PDF reports. No credit card required.

q2.question: Is my data secure?
q2.answer: Absolutely. We use industry-standard encryption, and your data is stored securely on trusted cloud infrastructure.

q3.question: Can I work offline?
q3.answer: Yes, with our Professional and Enterprise plans, you can work completely offline. Data syncs automatically when you reconnect.

q4.question: What languages are supported?
q4.answer: LapManagerPro supports English, Arabic (with RTL), French, and Spanish.

q5.question: Can I customize the PDF reports?
q5.answer: Yes! You can add your laboratory logo, customize headers and footers, and even add e-signatures to your reports.

q6.question: How do I get support?
q6.answer: We offer email support for all plans, with priority support for Professional users.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: At LapManagerPro, accessible from lapmanagerpro.com, one of our main priorities is the privacy of our visitors. This Privacy Policy document contains types of information that is collected and recorded by LapManagerPro and how we use it.

collection.title: Information We Collect
collection.description: The personal information that you are asked to provide, and the reasons why you are asked to provide it, will be made clear to you at the point we ask you to provide your personal information.

usage.title: How We Use Your Information
usage.description: We use the information we collect in various ways, including to provide, operate, and maintain our website, improve, personalize, and expand our website, and understand and analyze how you use our website.

sharing.title: Information Sharing
sharing.description: We do not share your personal information with third parties except as described in this privacy policy.

security.title: Data Security
security.description: We take reasonable measures to help protect information about you from loss, theft, misuse and unauthorized access, disclosure, alteration and destruction.

cookies.title: Cookies and Web Beacons
cookies.description: Like any other website, LapManagerPro uses 'cookies'. These cookies are used to store information including visitors' preferences, and the pages on the website that the visitor accessed or visited.

changes.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
changes.description: We may update our Privacy Policy from time to time. Thus, we advise you to review this page periodically for any changes.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.description: If you have any questions or suggestions about our Privacy Policy, do not hesitate to contact us.
